title: Cases of Employers Repatriating Injured Migrant Workers against Their Will
what_it_is: Cases of Employers Repatriating Injured Migrant Workers against Their Will

sections.label: MOM action against errant employers
sections.summary: MOM took action against two employers for illegal repatriation of migrant workers in the past five years, and describes required insurance coverage.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: The Ministry of Manpower (MOM) took action against two errant employers for illegal repatriation of migrant workers in the past five years.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: Under our laws, employers must buy medical insurance for migrant workers, which provides coverage of $15,000 and typically covers 95% of hospital bills arising from non-work injury.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: Most employers also buy work injury insurance coverage of at least $45,000 per accident, which will also cover 95% of work injury bills.

sections.label: MOM reviewing medical insurance coverage
sections.summary: MOM is reviewing medical insurance coverage, and between 2016 and 2020 there were 63 substantiated cases of employers not paying migrant workers' medical bills.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: MOM is reviewing medical insurance coverage to help employers better manage large unexpected medical expenses and give both employers and workers greater peace of mind.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: Between 2016 and 2020, there were 63 substantiated cases of employers not paying medical bills of their migrant workers.

sections.label: Hospitals treat serious injury cases
sections.summary: 95% of cases are covered by medical and work injury insurance, and hospitals committed to take in serious injury cases without LOGs with no delay in treatment.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: My sense, as I shared earlier, 95% of cases are covered by both the medical insurance as well as work injury compensation insurance.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: What the hospitals have committed to is that for serious injury cases, they would take them in, even without the LOGs.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: For that, there will be no delay in treatment.

sections.label: MOM pathway second half year
sections.summary: MOM has worked on a pathway to develop this in the second half of this year.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
sentences.text: MOM has worked on a pathway to develop this in the second half of this year.

sections.label: Special fund for remaining 5%
sections.summary: MOH together with MOM has a special fund to ensure no one is denied needed care for the additional 5%.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
sentences.text: For the additional 5%, MOH together with MOM, we have a special fund that is used to ensure that no one is actually denied the care that is needed to them.
